0022600197.text: The Lakers (8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West) head to Detroit on a four-game winning streak and a 3-1 road record, while the Pistons (6-2, first in the Central and third in the East) come in on a one-game losing streak. Luka Doncic is day-to-day with a back issue and is a game-time decision for the Lakers, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Elijah Harkless and Isaac Jones are day-to-day and game-time decisions for reasons not related to injury. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Lakers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
